# setup: the chapter library of the page (L = chapter 7 script and curve library, C = chapter 8 signature library, K = chapter 8 claims); the page boots these names
import sen0401_ch07_script_lib_v1_0_0 as L, sen0401_ch08_sig_lib_v1_0_0 as C, sen0401_ch08_claims_v1_0_0 as K

examples.name: Verification needs message, key and signature
examples.code:
sk, msg = K.SK, K.MSG
pk, sig = L.pubkey_create(sk), L.ecdsa_sign(sk, msg)
bad = bytes([msg[0] ^ 1]) + msg[1:]
other = L.pubkey_create(sk + 1)
v = lambda p, m: L.ecdsa_verify(p, m, sig)
checks = [v(pk, msg), v(pk, bad), v(other, msg)]
checks

examples.name: From identity proof to signature
examples.code:
x, k, e = 1234567, 7654321, 99999
pm, pa = L.point_mul, L.point_add
X, R = pm(x), pm(k)
s = (k + e * x) % L.N
chk = lambda t: pm(t) == pa(R, pm(e, X))
proof = [chk(s), chk(s + 1)]
sig = C.fs_sign(x, b'A', k)
sigs = [C.fs_verify(X, m, sig) for m in (b'A', b'B')]
sigs

examples.name: BIP340: x-only keys and 64-byte signatures
examples.code:
sk = 0x3b78ce563f89a0ed9414f5aa28ad0d96d6795f9c63
msg = L.sha256(b'ch08')
pub, sig = L.schnorr_pubkey(sk), L.schnorr_sign(sk, msg)
comp = L.pubkey_create(sk)
ecdsa = L.ecdsa_sign(sk, msg)
ok = L.schnorr_verify(pub, msg, sig)
sizes = [len(comp), len(pub), len(ecdsa), len(sig)]
sizes

examples.name: Policy is stricter than consensus
examples.code:
sig = L.ecdsa_sign(K.SK, K.MSG)
r, s = L.der_parse_lax(sig)[:2]
twin = L.der_encode(r, L.N - s)
pk = L.pubkey_create(K.SK)
ver = lambda g: L.ecdsa_verify(pk, K.MSG, g)
low = lambda g: L.is_low_s(g + b'\x01')
verdict = [(ver(g), low(g)) for g in (sig, twin)]
verdict

examples.name: A reused nonce gives away the private key
examples.code:
x, k, h1, h2 = 1234567, 7654321, 111, 222
r, s1 = C.ecdsa_sign_k(x, h1, k)
r2, s2 = C.ecdsa_sign_k(x, h2, k)
rec = C.recover_key_from_reused_nonce
got, k2 = rec(r, s1, h1, s2, h2)
fresh = C.ecdsa_sign_k(x, h2, k + 1)[0] != r
got == x

examples.name: RFC 6979: the nonce from key and message
examples.code:
h = L.sha256(b'sample')
k1 = C.rfc6979_k(L.N, K.SK, h)
k2 = C.rfc6979_k(L.N, K.SK, L.sha256(b'other'))
again = C.rfc6979_k(L.N, K.SK, h) == k1
same = L.ecdsa_sign(K.SK, h) == L.ecdsa_sign(K.SK, h)
again

examples.name: Hashing grows with the square of the inputs
examples.code:

new = [C.bip143_bytes_hashed(t) for t in txs]
ratio = [round(a / b, 1) for a, b in zip(old, new)]
ratio
